report.explanation: All current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services in the topology are unobserved, so the alert cannot be substantiated or attributed. Handing off for downstream evidence.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry showing the elevated checkout error rate and latency asserted by the alert
Per-service error/latency metrics for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql downstream of gateway
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiters metrics for downstream services, not only gateway
Logs/traces from downstream services covering the alert window
